description: Appends one entry to your hash-chained decision log. content_hash is the hash of your own RFC-8785-canonicalized decision record (never send the record itself -- see docs/decision-record-v1.md). seq starts at 0 and increments by 1 each call; prev must equal the previous entry's content_hash (omit only for seq=0). Returns a partially-signed transaction to sign and submit yourself.
name: prepare_decision_log
